description: Feature tests for Rook GraphRAG Knowledge System

tests.description: canonical.json validates against schema.json
test_steps: Expect: validation passes with no errors

tests.description: All node IDs follow type:name pattern
test_steps: Expect: all nodes have valid IDs

tests.description: All links reference existing nodes
test_steps: For each link, verify source and target exist in nodes

tests.description: Graph loads into NetworkX successfully
test_steps: Expect: returns DiGraph with correct node/edge count

tests.description: Query for 'nested layer' returns rhino_layer_create action
test_steps: Call knowledge_query with intent='create nested layer'
Expect: response includes pattern with parent param

tests.description: Query returns antipatterns for layer creation
Query response is under 500 tokens
test_steps: Call knowledge_query with any valid intent

tests.description: knowledge_query tool registered in MCP server
knowledge_record tool registered in MCP server
Recording success creates/strengthens pattern
test_steps: Verify pattern node weight increased or created

tests.description: Recording failure after correction creates antipattern
test_steps: Verify antipattern node created for failed approach

tests.description: Local knowledge merges with canonical
MCP knowledge_query callable from Claude Code
test_steps: In Claude Code session, call knowledge_query tool

tests.description: Knowledge query before rhino_layer_create shows parent pattern
test_steps: Query knowledge for 'nested layer' before calling rhino_layer_create
Expect: response shows parent parameter usage
Expect: response warns against :: in name

tests.description: Local knowledge persists across sessions
test_steps: Record a new pattern via knowledge_record

tests.description: Semantic similarity matches synonyms
Graph traversal finds related patterns
test_steps: Starting from intent node, traverse solved_by edge
From action node, traverse requires edges

tests.description: Query with unknown intent returns empty gracefully
test_steps: Expect: empty patterns array, no error

tests.description: Malformed record request returns error
test_steps: Call knowledge_record with missing required fields
Expect: error response with field name

tests.description: Patterns sorted by weight in response
test_steps: Add multiple patterns with different weights
Expect: patterns returned in weight descending order

tests.description: MAB model created on first knowledge_record
test_steps: Expect: mab_model.pkl created in knowledge/ directory

tests.description: MAB weights increase on repeated success
test_steps: Record same pattern as success multiple times
Expect: pattern weight higher than initial 0.5

tests.description: MAB weights decrease on failure
test_steps: Expect: pattern weight lower than after success

tests.description: MAB model persists across MCP restarts
test_steps: Expect: MAB weights still applied (not reset to static)

tests.description: Graceful fallback when MABWiser not installed
test_steps: Expect: returns patterns with static weights (no crash)

tests.description: No duplicate patterns in query response
test_steps: Query with intent that matches multiple actions linking same pattern
Expect: each pattern appears only once in response

tests.description: Failure records create intent node and link
test_steps: Record a failure with new intent
Expect: intent node created with solved_by link to action

tests.description: Failure records add antipattern to MAB
test_steps: Expect: antipattern tracked in MAB model

tests.description: Tool name validation warns on missing rhino_ prefix
test_steps: Expect: warning logged or tool normalized to rhino_create

tests.description: Hash IDs use sufficient length for collision resistance
test_steps: Check hash length in generated IDs
Expect: at least 12 hex chars (48 bits)
